content: पतिः [पा-डति] .²1 A master, lord; as in गृहपतिः. .²2 An owner, possessor, proprietor; क्षेत्रपतिः. .²3 Governor, ruler, one who presides over; ओषधीपतिः, वनस्पतिः, कुलपतिः <ab>&c.</ab> .²4 A husband; प्रमदाः पतिवर्त्मगा इति प्रतिपन्नं हि विचेतनैरपि <ls>Ku. 4. 33</ls>. .²5 A root. .²6 Going, motion, fight. --{%f.%} .²1 A female possessor, a mistress. .²2 A wife.
